purpose: Seek agreement or point out something emphatically in casual speech.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
This plan is good, is it not?
I told you before, did I not?
restrictions: It can sound confrontational depending on intonation.
mistake: A rhetorical じゃないか need not negate the proposition.

segments.role: Seek agreement or point out something emphatically in casual speech. Plain clause + じゃないか.
